skill_name: Compare and contrast the rise of the Soviet Union and the fall of the Iron Curtain.
workflow:
The rise of the Soviet Union and the fall of the Iron Curtain represent two major shifts in the geopolitical landscape of the twentieth century. 

The rise of the Soviet Union began in 1917, with the October Revolution and establishment of the Soviet state. The October Revolution overthrew the Tsarist Autocracy, setting the stage for a longer period of Marxist-Leninist rule in the USSR.
